description: Traceable catalog of Calinium capabilities implemented by the current theme. It describes implementation; it does not create Shopify configuration.

capabilities.name: Typography
capabilities.description: Theme-editor font families, type scales, line heights, and heading tracking are exposed as global settings and emitted as Calinium tokens.

capabilities.name: Color schemes
capabilities.description: Global color schemes and a default color-scheme selector are available to sections that expose a color_scheme setting.

capabilities.name: Spacing and layout
capabilities.description: Page width, content width, gutters, section spacing, and grid gap are global theme settings with token fallbacks.

capabilities.name: Motion and reduced-motion behavior
capabilities.description: Global motion toggles and duration settings are implemented with token-based motion and reduced-motion fallbacks.

capabilities.name: Responsive media
capabilities.description: Sections render Shopify-hosted responsive imagery through the canonical responsive-image primitive and use native video controls where available.

capabilities.name: Section composition
capabilities.description: The installed Shopify sections are the real composition surface; schemas, presets, blocks, and assets are audited in theme-section-capabilities.json.

capabilities.name: Hero media
capabilities.description: The theme includes banner, slideshow, editorial, split, full-screen, and video hero sections with schema-configured media and content controls.

capabilities.name: Canonical product cards
capabilities.description: Product listings compose the canonical product-card, price, product-form, and responsive-image primitives.

capabilities.name: Commerce and merchandising
capabilities.description: Product and collection merchandising sections reuse the canonical product card and existing cart enhancement infrastructure.

capabilities.name: Header and navigation
capabilities.description: Header and announcement-bar schemas provide merchant-configured navigation and announcement controls.

capabilities.name: Footer
capabilities.description: The footer schema provides merchant-controlled footer content and navigation blocks.

capabilities.name: Cart
capabilities.description: Cart drawer and cart-page behavior use the existing cart JavaScript and Shopify cart forms.

capabilities.name: Search and filters
capabilities.description: Search, predictive search, collection filtering, and sort controls have dedicated Shopify sections and existing enhancement assets.

capabilities.name: Editorial content
capabilities.description: Editorial and image-led storytelling uses canonical section-heading, rich-text, button, media-item, and icon primitives.

capabilities.name: Brand storytelling
capabilities.description: Factual brand-story sections are controlled by the existing AI manifest, setting metadata, block taxonomy, and content-safety rules.

capabilities.name: Trust content
capabilities.description: Testimonials, FAQ, certifications, and related factual proof sections exist, but factual inputs remain subject to content-safety classifications.

capabilities.name: Blog and articles
capabilities.description: Blog, article, and featured-blog sections are available with Shopify article objects and canonical article-card metadata.

capabilities.name: Newsletter capture
capabilities.description: A newsletter section uses Shopify’s customer form rather than a separate marketing endpoint.
